messages:
jordan: Heads-up — after this morning's VPC endpoint policy tighten + the updated KMS key policy, our warm-pool and burst GPU instances in us-west-2 are failing KMS decrypts during node bootstrap. join rate down ~50% in the impacted AZ. seeing AccessDenied with missing source-vpc condition.

jordan: sample log lines:
```
ERROR keystore.decrypt region=us-west-2 node=wp-43 status=403 error=AccessDenied message="MissingCondition: key policy requires aws:SourceVpc=vpc-0abc1234" grant=gr-a1b2c3
WARN warm-pool.join node=wp-43 reason="keystore handshake failed"
```

sana: that key policy change was meant to lock down decrypts to our control plane VPC only. seems the privatelink endpoint traffic is showing source VPC = vpce-eni (or different private IP) so the condition doesn't match. did we miss a vpce clause?

kai: yep. the policy uses `Condition: StringEquals { "aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abc1234" }`. traffic coming via the keystore privatelink interface endpoint has SourceVpc unset or set to the endpoint's ENI metadata which is not our control VPC. result: KMS denies. this is different from the earlier ViaService problem.

frank: urgent mitigations: 1) add a short-lived key grant that allows decrypt from the warm-pool role (fast, KMS API), 2) relax the key policy to allow aws:SourceVpce for the keystore endpoint, 3) temporary fw change to route warm-pool traffic through a fallback keystore proxy hosted in our control VPC. prefer (1) for immediate unlock.

ivy: cost/tracking note: fallback proxy will incur extra cross-AZ egress and proxy costs ~ $700-1.2k/day; creating temporary grants has negligible infra cost but needs careful audit trail. SOC wants grant ARNs recorded.

sana: I can issue a temporary grant scoped to the warm-pool role ARNs for the affected grants (gr-a1b2c3, gr-d4e5f6). KMS API call will be `CreateGrant(KeyId=..., GranteePrincipal=arn:aws:iam::acct:role/warmpool-role, Operations:["Decrypt"])`. we should set `RetiringPrincipal` and expire/retire quickly.

jordan: good. @sana, please create the grants and post the grant ARN(s) in the ticket. ops will tag them for audit and we will retire them after fix.

kai: parallel work: frank can you draft the key policy change to add `StringEquals: { "aws:SourceVpce": "vpce-0keystore" }` and a fallback to allow the keystore principal when request originates from the control plane. that'll be the longer-term fix but needs sec review.

frank: will draft PR for key policy update and include a canary plan. also plan to add unit test to our infra-policy linter to catch SourceVpc vs SourceVpce mismatches when privatelink endpoints are in use.

ivy: I've alerted billing-ops for the proxy cost range; they pre-approved up to $1.5k/day for 72h if we need proxy fallback. recommend retrying grant path first.

ops-bot: INC-8610 created for KMS decrypt failures. Linked tasks: KMS-GRANT-137, FW-CR-6110 (fallback proxy). Estimated cost impact $950/day if fallback proxy used. Escalate to security@redwood if temporary grants remain >2h.

frank: timeline proposal: (a) sana issues temporary decrypt grants (0-15m), (b) verify warm-pool join recovery (15-45m), (c) open PR for key policy `SourceVpce` change (30-90m), (d) after sec review and canary, retire temporary grants and close FW-CR if created.

sana: done — created grants grantee=arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/warmpool-role grantARN=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:grant/gt-334455; posted to the ticket and set RetireAfter=2h. monitoring now.

jordan: joins recovered to ~98% within 10 minutes of grant creation. KMS 403 spike dropped. thanks.

kai: good. followups: add infra-policy linter rule, add a canary that runs a warm-pool node bootstrap in CI after any KMS or VPC endpoint policy change, and update runbook to prefer temporary KMS grants when key policies are tight.

frank: PR opened for key policy update: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7512 — adds `aws:SourceVpce` allowance for vpce-0keystore and documents the change. requesting sec review + integration test that uses privatelink stub.

ivy: SOC ok with temporary grants + logs archived for 90d. I added `keystore-kms-temp` tag to the incident.

ops-bot: INC-8610 updated: status=mitigated, mitigation=KMS-GRANT-137 + PR-7512, est-resolve=+2h. Reminder: retire grants or escalate to security if open >2h.

jordan: adding postmortem bullets: cause = key policy `aws:SourceVpc` incompatible with privatelink endpoint path; detection = warm-pool join drops + KMS 403s; mitigation = temporary scoped grants + key policy update to `SourceVpce`; followups = linter rule, warm-pool canary for KMS changes, runbook update for grant-retire automation.

sana: will retire grant early if PR merges and canary passes. closing thread when grant retired and PR merged.
